js: const M = globalThis.__muster; const w = await M.rpc.call('workspace.add', {path: '/tmp', name: 'notes-app'}); await M.rpc.call('channel.create', {workspace_id: w.id, name: 'notes-app', agent: 'shell', window_id: M.windowId.value}); return 'channel';
const M = globalThis.__muster; const v = M.channelLayout.value; M.channelLayout.value = {...v, sidebar: {...v.sidebar, hidden: true}};

const f = document.createElement('textarea'); f.id = 'typing-field'; f.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:24px;bottom:24px;width:360px;height:60px;z-index:99;font:14px system-ui'; f.placeholder = 'Typing elsewhere'; document.body.append(f); f.focus(); f.value = 'Typing a note while both merges run'; return document.activeElement?.id;

const a = document.activeElement; if (a?.id !== 'typing-field') throw new Error('focus moved to ' + (a ? a.tagName + '.' + a.className : 'nothing')); return {focus: a.id, shown: document.querySelector('.prs-view .qv-q')?.textContent};
